brand_identity.name: Angel Cables
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Industrial Authority, Engineering Precision, Uncompromising Safety
brand_identity.description: A high-end industrial wire and cable manufacturer. The design must feel like a precision tool—clean, sharp, and engineered.

typography.rules: Do not center headings by default. Use 'Chivo' for all headings. Use 'Manrope' for body text. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for technical specs (voltage, diameter).

colors.gradients: No CSS gradients. Use mesh gradients or subtle noise overlays only.

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-24. Containers must breathe.
rules: Footer must be massive (min-height 400px) and dark.

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) to the entire body to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard shadows for buttons (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]). Soft ambient shadows for cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thin, crisp borders (1px) in standard state. Thicker borders (2px) on hover.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the navigation bar: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-black/5.

buttons.primary: bg-orange-600 text-white hover:bg-orange-700 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-slate-900 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide

cards.product: bg-white border border-slate-200 p-0 hover:border-orange-500 transition-colors group overflow-hidden relative
cards.feature: bg-slate-50 p-8 border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200 hover:bg-white transition-all

components.badges: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider border border-slate-200

motion.micro_interactions: Buttons should have a magnetic feel or strict hard-press effect.

info.address: B-70/32, DSIDC, Lawrence Road Industrial Area, Delhi-110035

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or noise textures.
Typography must be BIG. If you think it's big enough, make it bigger.
Images must have 'alt' tags for SEO.
Mobile first: Ensure all grids collapse to 1 column on mobile.
Ensure high contrast for text (APCA standards).
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the Angel Cables website. Use the extracted image URLs provided. If a specific product image fails to load, fallback to the 'armoured' or generic wire image. The design should feel 'Heavy' and 'Reliable' - think Caterpillar or DeWalt but for cables. Use the 'Orange' accent sparingly but effectively.
